summary: The earlier fixes are present, but two account-selection paths still bypass Team-first ordering.

findings.evidence: Failure recovery passes only measuredAccounts(model) to decideSwitch. If the current Team fails, a recognized unread Team has a free seat, and a measured Ultra satisfies the exception, recovery selects the Ultra. Refresh rescue likewise omits unreadTeams at server.ts:4604, and moveUpWait uses only measured candidates at server.ts:6916. The subsequent dispatch retains the now-current Ultra through src/switch.ts:710–730, so chooseTeamsFirst never corrects this new-account selection.
findings.fix: Include eligible unread Teams in failure recovery, refresh rescue, and wait-release selection before exception accounts. Reuse the placement candidate logic while preserving known blocking windows, refusal checks, failed-account exclusions, and seat availability. Add server-level regression coverage for these callers.

findings.evidence: The current-full branch filters by aheadThreshold before applying Team priority. With switchAheadOtherPercent=80, a full current account, another usable Team at 85% session with one free seat, and an eligible Ultra at 20% with room, the Team is removed from roomy and the Ultra is selected at lines 752–755. decideAhead applies the same filtering at lines 974–980. These are new-account choices that put the Ultra ahead of a Team with quota and a seat, contrary to the plan's unqualified Team-first rule.
findings.fix: Check usable Teams with free seats before allowing an exception account to win through the switch-ahead filter. For seat moves, prioritize the Team; for proactive moves, retain the current account if preserving the configured headroom rule precludes choosing that Team. Cover both paths with the threshold enabled.

coverage: Verified the plan SHA-256, all 15 changed-file hashes, and the tracked diff hash.
Reviewed every changed file's additions and relevant surrounding code, including tests, documentation, scripts, and package metadata.
Traced placement, failure and leftover retries, refresh rescue, pins, switch-ahead, crowded seat moves, wait selection and release, and final dispatch guards.
Inspected usage parsing and caching, plan classification, project-model and excursion state, account-variable writes, seat reservation and admission, and esperandoTeam reporting.
limitations: Static review only: no files edited, tests or mutation scripts run, or work delegated.
Large existing files were inspected in relevant sections rather than exhaustively.
External operational measurements and live provider behavior were not independently verified.
Respected the accepted existing-account retention decision. The documented esperandoTeam mislabel remains an acknowledged limitation.
